titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, CBC News
mainText: Russian missiles landed in Poland, and NATO characterized the incident as a violation of airspace.
French police officers received sentences for beating music producer Michel Zecler.
The S&P 500 declined 3.7% and the Nasdaq composite entered negative territory for the year.
Actor Gérard Depardieu and a French author are under investigation regarding sexual allegations.
President Trump held a press conference following meetings with President Xi Jinping of China and President Putin of Russia.
